footnotes: From pre-tax income to net income to Spire: after $15.1M of preferred dividends.

Figures are from the company's Form 10-K for fiscal years ended Sep 30, 2025 and a year earlier, as filed with the SEC (income statement lines as the filing presents them); free cash flow = operating cash flow − capital expenditures. Never estimated: items the filing does not report are left out.
Percentages are of revenue; figures may not sum due to rounding.

summary: Revenue fell 4.5% to $2.5B in fiscal 2025 (ended Sep 30, 2025). Operating income rose 7.3% to $524M, a 21.2% margin.
Net income rose 8.8% to $257M, or $4.37 per share. Operating cash flow was $578M and free cash flow −$344M, versus $51.1M; Spire returned $182M through dividends.
sources: Spire Inc. Form 10-K for FY2025 (SEC EDGAR)
